{{Top|leg}}
The '''Neoclassical period''' was a cultural movement that arose inside the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] in which [[Music/Legends|music]] such as the [[Harbin-re opera]], [[ganther dance]]s and [[Waltz/Legends|waltzes]] by [[Nabicci Futana]], and [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]-era [[March (music)|marches]] were composed. The [[Imperial Symphony Orchestra]] was scheduled to play such pieces during its [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] tour starting in [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]]. [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] favored neoclassical music.
